terminalContract: Each UI transition invokes one named publication intent: WorkflowSession publishes shared selector, device, and run facts while Merge and Replace publish only their own page facts; an accepted live mode selection never republishes its ModeChoices ItemsSource, session IcChoices, or the hidden page, while full and canonical catalog refreshes retain authoritative choice publication and existing ordering

designReview.evidence: Independent R2 architecture review approved replacing the v1.0.2 caller-selectable owner/Boolean notification suppression with flag-free full-context and accepted-mode intents on the existing WorkflowSession, Merge, and Replace owners. WorkflowSession remains the sole publisher of shared selector/device/run facts, each page remains the sole publisher of its ModeChoices and page projections, live accepted mode changes cannot republish ItemsSource/IcChoices or wake the hidden page, and full Catalog refresh retains authoritative choice publication. The bounded refactor changes no XAML, navigation, Application, firmware, composition, range, CRC, naming, or execution semantics and introduces no publication framework or second state owner.
